push-in.caption: The camera dollies forward with a very smooth and steady motion, showing no shaking.

pull-out.caption: The camera smoothly dollies backward, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

zoom-in.caption: The camera smoothly zooms in, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

zoom-out.caption: The camera smoothly zooms out, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

pan-left.caption: The camera smoothly pans left, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

pan-right.caption: The camera smoothly pans right, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

truck-left.caption: The camera smoothly trucks left, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

truck-right.caption: The camera smoothly trucks right, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

tilt-up.caption: The camera tilts up smoothly, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

tilt-down.caption: The camera tilts down smoothly, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

pedestal-up.caption: The camera smoothly pedestals upward, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

pedestal-down.caption: The camera smoothly pedestals downward, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

arc.caption: The camera arcs smoothly in a clockwise direction, maintaining a steady and fluid motion without any shaking.

tracking.caption: The camera smoothly trucks right, maintaining a steady focus as it tracks the subject from the side.

static.caption: The camera remains completely fixed, exhibiting no movement or shaking.

shake-slightly.caption: The camera remains fixed but slightly unsteady, with no intentional movement.

shake-strongly.caption: The camera vibrates erratically, lacking a clear pattern in its movement.

roll-cw.caption: The camera rolls smoothly clockwise, offering a high-angle view of the white structure without any shaking.

roll-ccw.caption: The camera rolls smoothly in a counterclockwise direction, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

pov.caption: The camera, embodying a first-person perspective in an FPS game, smoothly tracks a comrade from behind. It begins by moving forward, then pans to the right midway, continuing in that direction with minimal shaking.

small-amplitude.caption: The camera tilts down smoothly, exhibiting minor movement without any shaking.

large-amplitude.caption: The drone swiftly flies in a complex and dynamic pattern, energetically panning right to track a group of oncoming motorcyclists as they turn on a race track. The camera maintains a fast pace and remains very smooth with no shaking throughout.

slow-speed.caption: The camera pans left slowly, maintaining a very smooth and steady motion without any shaking.

fast-speed.caption: The camera quickly pans left with a smooth motion, exhibiting minimal shaking.

whip-pan-right.caption: The camera quickly pans right with a very smooth motion, showing no shaking.

crash-zoom.caption: The camera quickly zooms in with a smooth and steady motion, maintaining minimal shaking throughout.

dolly-zoom.caption: The camera smoothly moves backward while simultaneously zooming in during the first half, creating a dolly zoom effect with minimal shaking.

crane-up.caption: The camera cranes upward in a smooth arc, maintaining a steady and fluid motion throughout.

crane-down.caption: The camera smoothly cranes down in an arc, maintaining minimal shaking throughout the movement.

orbit-ccw.caption: The camera arcs counterclockwise with smooth movement and minimal shaking.

lead-tracking.caption: The camera smoothly moves backward, leading the subject from the front with minimal shaking.

tail-tracking.caption: The camera smoothly dollies forward, following the subject from behind with minimal shaking.

drone-shot.caption: The camera smoothly trucks right, maintaining a steady aerial perspective as it tracks the subject from the side.

slow-push-in.caption: The camera moves forward slowly with a smooth, steady motion, exhibiting minimal shaking.

pull-back-reveal.caption: The camera smoothly moves backward while slightly rolling counterclockwise, revealing the entire scene with a steady, fluid motion.

whip-pan-left.caption: The camera quickly pans left with a very smooth motion, showing no shaking.

orbit-cw.caption: The camera arcs clockwise with smooth movement and minimal shaking.

side-tracking.caption: The camera smoothly trucks right, maintaining a steady focus as it tracks the subject from the side.

handheld.caption: The camera remains fixed but slightly unsteady, with no intentional movement.
